village.khortytsia.name: Khortytsia
building.field.name: Wheat field
building.field.desc: Bread for the farm and provisions for the Sich.
building.garden.name: Kitchen garden
building.garden.desc: Cabbage, beets and onions — and provisions for the Cossacks.
building.apiary.name: Apiary
building.apiary.desc: Honey to sell and to store.
building.windmill.name: Windmill
building.windmill.desc: Grinds flour. The stronger the wind, the bigger the income.
building.potter.name: Potter's house
building.potter.desc: Jugs, bowls and pots for the fair.
building.smithy.name: Smithy
building.smithy.desc: Forges weapons: each level adds to the army's strength.
building.tavern.name: Tavern
building.tavern.desc: Where Cossacks make songs of glory: each level adds glory.
building.fair.name: Fair
sich.kurins.name: Kurins
sich.kurins.desc: Room for Cossacks beyond what the provisions feed.
sich.maidan.name: Maidan
sich.maidan.desc: Drill and the Cossack council: a stronger army.
sich.walls.name: Ramparts, palisade and gate
sich.walls.desc: Defence: the farms are at peace, and earn more.
sich.treasury.name: Treasury
sich.treasury.desc: A bigger store for glory while you are away.
sich.church.name: Church of the Intercession
sich.church.desc: More glory. Opens when every farm building reaches level 25.
sich.cannonry.name: Cannon foundry
sich.cannonry.desc: Gunners and the power of cannons.
sich.special.name: The land's own building
sich.special.khortytsia.name: Watchtower
sich.special.khortytsia.desc: Lookouts see the enemy from afar: more defence.
story.khortytsia.shore.title: The Dnipro Shore
story.khortytsia.shore.text: Below the rapids the Dnipro runs wide, and by Khortytsia the banks rise high and rocky. Here, on free land, a new khutir takes root — time to set to work.
story.khortytsia.messenger.title: A Messenger from the Fort
story.khortytsia.messenger.text: A messenger has come from Prince Dmytro Vyshnevetskyi. Around the 1550s Cossacks are raising a fort on the island of Mala Khortytsia — an earthen rampart and a palisade. The prince calls for men willing to serve.
story.khortytsia.council.title: Council on the Maidan
story.khortytsia.council.text: The Cossacks have gathered for a council. Here on the maidan they settle the affairs of the Host together and elect the koshovyi otaman, the chief of the whole Host.
story.khortytsia.pokrova.title: Consecration of Pokrova
story.khortytsia.pokrova.text: A church has risen over the Sich. The Zaporozhian Cossacks honoured the Protection of the Mother of God (Pokrova) as their patron, and Sich churches were often consecrated in her name.
ui.unlock.farmAll: Opens when every farm building is level {level}
ui.hire.name: Hire Cossacks
ui.hire.desc: They win glory. Each eats {kharch} food.
ui.hire.buttonFull: Hire a Cossack: not enough food
ui.settings.title: Settings
return.title: Welcome back!
return.clockBack: The device clock was set back, so nothing was earned for that time.
return.nothing: Nothing was earned meanwhile: build something on the farm first.
boot.restored.title: Save restored
boot.restored.body: The latest save was damaged, so the copy before it was loaded. A few seconds of play may be lost.
boot.corrupt.title: Save damaged
boot.corrupt.body: Neither copy of the save can be read, so a new game has started.
boot.newer.title: Update the game
boot.newer.body: This save comes from a newer version of the game. Update to continue: until then progress is not saved.
tab.elsewhere.title: Already open
tab.elsewhere.body: The farm is open in another tab. Play there: two tabs would overwrite one save.
boot.unavailable.title: Saving unavailable
boot.unavailable.body: The browser will not let the game read its save (private mode or blocked storage). You can play, but this progress will not be saved.
start.error.title: The game did not start
start.error.body: Something went wrong while starting. Reload the page; your save is untouched.

raid.tier.m5.name: Scouting
raid.tier.m5.text: A few Cossacks ride round the nearby lands and soon come back with news.
raid.tier.m30.name: Patrol
raid.tier.m30.text: The squad rides the banks and the steppe roads.
raid.tier.h1.name: Outpost
raid.tier.h1.text: The squad keeps watch at a crossing and guards the road.
raid.tier.h4.name: Campaign
raid.tier.h4.text: A long road over steppe and water, back by evening.
raid.tier.h8.name: Long campaign
raid.tier.h8.text: For the night: the squad rides far and returns in the morning.
raid.rumor.chumaky.name: The chumaks say
raid.rumor.chumaky.text: The chumaks say the road is clear: the loot will be richer.
raid.rumor.ford.name: The ford is low
raid.rumor.ford.text: The water has fallen and the crossing is easy: the squad brings back more.
raid.rumor.kurgan.name: Old kurgans
raid.rumor.kurgan.text: The old folk say there are ancient kurgans out there, so a relic is easier to find.
region.khortytsia.samara.name: Samara
region.khortytsia.samara.text: A left tributary of the Dnipro above the rapids, with pine woods and fishing pools.
region.khortytsia.vovchiVody.name: Vovchi Vody
region.khortytsia.vovchiVody.text: A tributary of the Samara far to the east, in the open steppe.
region.khortytsia.porohy.name: The Rapids
region.khortytsia.porohy.text: Ridges of stone cross the Dnipro above Khortytsia; only skilled helmsmen go there by water.
region.khortytsia.kinskiVody.name: Kinski Vody
region.khortytsia.kinskiVody.text: A steppe river flowing from the east to the Velykyi Luh.
region.khortytsia.tavan.name: Tavan
region.khortytsia.tavan.text: A crossing on the lower Dnipro where the steppe roads met.
region.khortytsia.dykePole.name: The Wild Fields
region.khortytsia.dykePole.text: Endless steppe east and south of the Sich, with grass up to a rider’s stirrups.
relic.pernach.name: Pernach
relic.pernach.text: The Host follows whoever holds the pernach: +{value} % power.
relic.pernach.fact: A pernach is a mace with metal ribs, the «feathers». Among the Cossacks it was a sign of authority, notably a colonel’s.
relic.porokhivnytsia.name: Powder flask
relic.porokhivnytsia.text: An old carved powder flask brings luck on the road: +{value} % loot.
relic.porokhivnytsia.fact: Powder flasks were made of horn, wood or leather and often carved; a Cossack wore his at the belt.
